title: ARGUS realized-fill impact calibration verified
summary: ARGUS now compares its static TRUE_DEPTH displayed-book impact baseline with later realized fills. Calibration records snapshot age, completion latency, predicted-versus-realized fill fraction, adverse slippage error, displayed-depth utilization, book-exhaustion state and aggregate signed/absolute/RMSE error. Depth curves and calibration observations are self-validated before aggregation. This is retrospective calibration evidence only and does not claim that displayed depth predicts future fills or grant execution authority.
